correctness.rationale: The explicit unweighted tube-simplex Minkowski sum is full dimensional and cyclically invariant. Its interior invariant center yields a global equivariant radial homeomorphism with the sphere of the coordinate-sum-zero representation. An order-p rotation of n=kp coordinates is k regular modules minus one trivial line; its nontrivial Fourier planes all carry unit weights modulo p. Thus the moving sphere has free C_p action, and the quotient is exactly the (k-1)-fold unreduced suspension of the specified lens space. Standard cellular chain computation gives Z/p in degrees k,k+2,...,n-4, free top homology in degree n-2; the lens universal cover or suspension connectivity/Hurewicz gives pi_k=Z/p. Exact finite checker constructs full dual boundary and quotient chain for n=5 and checks the arithmetic multiplicities; it is corroboration not the infinite proof. No hidden generic-position hypothesis, group-order ambiguity or unsupported finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: A complete natural classification of geometric prime-order rotation quotients of cycle graph-associahedron boundaries, specifying actual homeomorphism types (not just homology ranks) uniformly for all n=kp and p>=5. It pinpoints genuine integral torsion and arbitrarily delayed first nontrivial homotopy even though the starting complex is a sphere, giving a concrete canonical source of lens-space suspensions. The proof is concise because its ingredients are classical, but the precise object, symmetry, torsion degrees and homotopy groups are motivated and useful for equivariant polytope topology; not an arbitrary finite slice or numerical increment.
